verdict.rationale: The evidence shows LlamaParse only in the MCP server role: it exposes Parse, Classify, Extract, Split and Index tools at mcp.llamaindex.ai, and it offers a docs MCP server. Nothing documents LlamaParse acting as an MCP client that can register external MCP servers and call their tools. Server-side evidence belongs to a different story and cannot be credited here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
